food.name: Figlmüller Wollzeile
food.blurb: Plate-sized Wiener schnitzel, pounded thin, served since 1905. Book a table; the queue is real.

food.name: Dom Schnitzel
food.blurb: Classic Wiener schnitzel a few steps from Stephansdom.

food.name: Ramen Makotoya
food.blurb: Ramen by the Rathaus, with more branches in Neubau and Landstraße.

food.name: Lola
food.q: Lola Spanisches Tapas Restaurant, Gonzagagasse 14, Wien
food.blurb: Spanish tapas in the old town. Order a lot of small plates and share.

cafe.name: Café Sperl
cafe.blurb: Billiard tables, marble tops, newspapers on sticks. Order a Melange and an apple strudel and stay an hour.

sights.name: Schönbrunn Palace
sights.blurb: The Habsburg summer palace. Climb to the Gloriette for the view.

sights.name: Stephansdom
sights.blurb: The cathedral at the center of everything. 343 steps up the south tower.

sights.name: Prunksaal, National Library
sights.blurb: The baroque State Hall of the Austrian National Library: frescoed dome, 200,000 old books, and one of the most beautiful rooms in Europe.

sights.name: Belvedere Palace
sights.blurb: Two baroque palaces facing each other across terraced gardens. Klimt's The Kiss hangs in the Upper Belvedere.

sights.name: Prater & the Riesenrad
sights.blurb: Ride the 1897 Giant Ferris Wheel, then the coasters and beer gardens of the Wurstelprater.

sights.name: Naschmarkt
sights.blurb: Graze a mile of food stalls: falafel, cheese, oysters, Turkish sweets. Saturday adds a flea market.

sights.name: Gänsehäufel swim
sights.blurb: An island lido on the Alte Donau: lawns, warm lake water and a break from the city's heat.

sights.name: Film Festival on Rathausplatz
sights.blurb: Free open-air concert films outside City Hall every night into early September, with food stalls.

trips.name: Wachau Valley
trips.blurb: Terraced vineyards and apricot orchards along the Danube. Bike from Krems to Dürnstein and climb to the castle ruin.

trips.name: Kahlenberg & Vienna Woods
trips.blurb: Hike the vineyard trails above the city and finish with a view over all of Vienna.

trips.name: Lednice–Valtice
trips.time: 1 h by train to Břeclav + 15 min bus
trips.blurb: A UNESCO landscape of palaces, follies and a minaret in the middle of Moravian wine country.

trips.name: Hallstatt & Salzkammergut
trips.time: Full-day guided tour, about 3.5 h each way
trips.blurb: The lakeside village in the Alps that looks like a postcard, plus the mountains and lakes of the Salzkammergut on the way.

food.name: Lokál Dlouhááá
food.blurb: Svíčková, fried cheese and the best-kept Pilsner Urquell in town, poured straight from the tank.

food.name: U Tří jelínků
food.blurb: A traditional Czech restaurant on Nerudova, the steep lane up to the castle. Easy stop on the way up or down.

food.name: Oishi Praha
food.blurb: Sushi and Japanese dishes in the center, with branches on Spálená and V Celnici.

food.name: Lore Malastrana
food.blurb: Homemade Italian cooking from Chef Lore, on a quiet lane below the castle in Malá Strana.

food.name: Pho Vietnam Tuan & Lan
food.blurb: A local favorite for steaming bowls of pho, a short walk from Vinohrady.

cafe.name: Café Savoy
cafe.blurb: Painted Neo-Renaissance ceiling, a pastry case worth the walk, and a great breakfast before the castle.

sights.name: Charles Bridge
sights.blurb: Go at sunrise before the crowds. It's empty, and the light is perfect.

sights.name: Prague Castle
sights.blurb: The largest ancient castle complex in the world, plus St. Vitus Cathedral.

sights.name: Old Town Square
sights.blurb: The Astronomical Clock strikes the hour. Watch it once.

sights.name: Letná Beer Garden
sights.blurb: Cheap beer under chestnut trees with the whole city below you. Best at sunset.

sights.name: Vyšehrad
sights.blurb: The other castle hill: ramparts over the river, Dvořák's grave and far fewer people.

sights.name: Pedal boats on the Vltava
sights.blurb: Rent a pedal boat off Slavonic Island and float past the National Theatre. Swan-shaped ones too.

sights.name: Petřín lookout tower
sights.blurb: Funicular up the hill, then 299 steps up the mini Eiffel Tower for the best view of the spires.

sights.name: Náplavka riverbank
sights.blurb: Saturday farmers' market, then boat bars and food stalls along the river into the evening.

trips.name: Karlštejn Castle
trips.blurb: A Gothic castle on a wooded hill, built to guard Charles IV's crown jewels. Walk up from the village.

trips.name: Kutná Hora
trips.blurb: An old silver-mining town with a soaring cathedral and the famous bone chapel at Sedlec.

trips.name: Bohemian Switzerland
trips.blurb: Sandstone towers and gorges. Hike to Pravčická brána, Europe's largest natural rock arch, and take a boat through the Kamenice gorge.

sights.name: Lednice Chateau
sights.blurb: A neo-Gothic palace with a huge glasshouse and an English park you can explore by boat.

sights.name: The Minaret
sights.blurb: A 60 m minaret folly in the park. Climb it for views across the whole estate.

sights.name: Valtice Chateau & wine salon
sights.blurb: Baroque palace whose cellars hold the National Wine Salon: taste the best 100 Czech wines.

sights.name: Colonnade on Reistna
sights.blurb: A hilltop colonnade above Valtice with views over the vineyards toward Austria.

sights.name: Dürnstein Abbey
sights.blurb: The blue-and-white baroque tower on the riverbank, the postcard of the whole valley.

sights.name: Kuenringer Castle ruin
sights.blurb: A short steep climb to the ruin where Richard the Lionheart was held, with the best view of the Danube.

sights.name: Weißenkirchen
sights.blurb: A wine village of fortified churches and Heurigen, surrounded by terraced Riesling vineyards.

sights.name: Krems old town
sights.blurb: The gateway town of the valley: rent bikes here, then ride the river path to Dürnstein.

sights.name: Kahlenberg viewpoint
sights.blurb: The terrace above the vineyards with all of Vienna and the Danube laid out below.

sights.name: Leopoldsberg
sights.blurb: The neighbouring hilltop with a small castle church and an even steeper drop to the river.

sights.name: Kahlenbergerdorf
sights.blurb: A tiny wine village at the foot of the hill. The Nussberg trail runs from here through the vineyards.

sights.name: Grinzing
sights.blurb: The classic Heuriger village. Walk down here and end the hike with wine in a garden.

sights.name: Marktplatz
sights.blurb: The tiny market square of painted houses between the lake and the mountain.

sights.name: Skywalk World Heritage View
sights.blurb: A platform hanging off the cliff 350 m above the village. Take the funicular up.

sights.name: Salt mine
sights.blurb: The world's oldest salt mine, with miners' slides between levels.

sights.name: Bone House
sights.blurb: A chapel of painted skulls, a local tradition from when the churchyard ran out of space.

sights.name: Karlštejn Castle
sights.blurb: Charles IV's treasure castle. Book the tour of the Great Tower to see the gilded chapel.

sights.name: Karlštejn village
sights.blurb: The walk up from the station through the village is half the fun, past cafés and a wax museum.

sights.name: Velká Amerika quarry
sights.blurb: A flooded limestone quarry nicknamed the Czech Grand Canyon, an hour's hike from the castle.

sights.name: Sedlec Ossuary
sights.blurb: A chapel decorated with the bones of some 40,000 people, including a bone chandelier.

sights.name: St. Barbara's Church
sights.blurb: A soaring Gothic cathedral built by the silver miners, with tent-like roofs.

sights.name: Italian Court
sights.blurb: The old royal mint where the silver Prague groschen was struck.

sights.name: Sedlec Cathedral
sights.q: Katedrála Nanebevzetí Panny Marie a sv. Jana Křtitele
sights.blurb: A bright Gothic-baroque cathedral next to the ossuary, often skipped and well worth it.

sights.name: Pravčická brána
sights.blurb: Europe's largest natural sandstone arch, a steady 1.5 h hike from Hřensko.

sights.name: Edmund's Gorge boats
sights.blurb: Wooden boats poled through a narrow gorge by boatmen who tell jokes in Czech.

sights.name: Hřensko
sights.blurb: The village squeezed into the canyon where the Kamenice meets the Elbe. Start here.

sights.name: Mezní Louka
sights.blurb: The trail junction on the ridge between the arch and the gorges, with a lodge for lunch.

food.name: Konoba Fetivi
food.blurb: A small family konoba in Veli Varoš serving the day's catch, grilled simply with olive oil and blitva.

food.name: Konoba Matejuška
food.blurb: A tiny place by the old fishermen's harbor. Order the fish of the day and the octopus.

food.name: Bokeria Kitchen & Wine
food.blurb: A lively market-style restaurant just outside the palace walls, with a long Croatian wine list.

food.name: Dvor
food.blurb: A garden terrace above Firule bay, a short walk past Bačvice. Seasonal Dalmatian cooking with the sea right below.

food.name: Zinfandel
food.q: Zinfandel Food & Wine Bar, Marulićeva 2, Split
food.blurb: A wine bar just off the old town's main square, with Croatian wines by the glass and plates to share.

food.name: Artičok
food.blurb: Modern Mediterranean plates built on local produce, a few minutes' walk from the palace.

sights.name: Peristyle
sights.blurb: The Roman courtyard at the heart of Diocletian's Palace, the emperor's retirement home that the whole old town now lives inside.

sights.name: Riva promenade
sights.blurb: The palm-lined waterfront where all of Split strolls at sunset.

sights.name: Marjan Hill
sights.blurb: A forested peninsula park with viewpoints, chapels and quiet swimming coves.

sights.name: Podrum
sights.blurb: The palace's vaulted cellars under the Peristyle: a market hall now, and Daenerys's dragon lair in Game of Thrones.

sights.name: St. Domnius bell tower
sights.blurb: Climb the Romanesque bell tower in the middle of the palace for views over the roofs to the islands.

sights.name: Meštrović Gallery
sights.blurb: The great Croatian sculptor's seaside villa, with his work in the rooms and the gardens.

sights.name: Bačvice beach
sights.blurb: The sandy city beach where locals play picigin, keeping a tiny ball in the air in the shallows.

sights.name: Kayak around Marjan
sights.blurb: Paddle from Kašjuni along the cliffs and coves under Marjan. Guided sunset trips run every evening.

trips.name: Trogir
trips.blurb: A UNESCO-listed medieval town on a tiny island, all stone lanes, palaces and a waterfront fortress.

trips.name: Hvar
trips.blurb: The island town with a hilltop fortress, lavender fields and boat trips to the Pakleni islands.

trips.name: Krka National Park
trips.blurb: A river of turquoise waterfalls and travertine terraces, explored on boardwalks and by boat.

trips.name: Blue Cave, Biševo
trips.blurb: A sea cave that glows electric blue when the late-morning sun shines in under the water. Speedboat tours pair it with Vis and Hvar.

trips.name: Plitvice Lakes
trips.blurb: Sixteen terraced turquoise lakes linked by waterfalls, walked on wooden boardwalks. Croatia's best-known national park.

trips.name: Mostar
trips.blurb: An Ottoman old town in Bosnia and Herzegovina around the arched Old Bridge, where divers leap into the river. Bring passports.

sights.name: Cathedral of St. Lawrence
sights.blurb: Its Romanesque portal by Master Radovan is one of the finest carvings on the Adriatic. Climb the tower.

sights.name: Kamerlengo Fortress
sights.blurb: A 15th-century Venetian fortress at the tip of the island, with walls you can walk.

sights.name: Trogir waterfront
sights.blurb: The palm-lined riva facing Čiovo, lined with cafés and yachts.

sights.name: Fortica fortress
sights.blurb: A short climb through pine trees to the fortress above town, with the best view of the islands.

sights.name: St. Stephen's Square
sights.blurb: One of the largest squares in Dalmatia, running from the cathedral down to the harbor.

sights.name: Pakleni islands
sights.blurb: Water taxis from the harbor go to pine-covered islets with beach bars and clear water.

sights.name: Skradinski buk
sights.blurb: The park's biggest cascade: 17 travertine steps, circled by a boardwalk loop (swimming is no longer allowed).

sights.name: Skradin
sights.blurb: A little riverside town where the park boats leave from. Good for lunch.

sights.name: Visovac monastery
sights.blurb: A Franciscan monastery on a tiny island in the river, reached on the boat tour.

sights.name: Blue Cave
sights.blurb: Small boats slip in through a low opening. Around midday, sun through an underwater gap lights the water a glowing blue. The visit inside is about 10 minutes.

sights.name: Stiniva cove
sights.blurb: A pebble beach behind a narrow gap in the cliffs on the south coast of Vis. Tours stop here for a swim.

sights.name: Komiža
sights.blurb: A fishing town under Mount Hum on Vis, where the boats tie up for lunch on the harbor.

sights.name: Veliki slap
sights.blurb: The Big Waterfall, 78 m high and the tallest in Croatia, at the end of the Lower Lakes canyon.

sights.name: Lower Lakes boardwalks
sights.blurb: Wooden walkways run right across the water of the narrow lower canyon, past falls and caves.

sights.name: Lake Kozjak boat
sights.blurb: The park's largest lake. An electric boat, included in the ticket, crosses it between the Lower and Upper Lakes.

sights.name: Upper Lakes
sights.blurb: Terraced lakes stepping down through beech forest, joined by dozens of small cascades under the boardwalks.

sights.name: Stari Most
sights.blurb: The 16th-century Ottoman bridge, rebuilt in 2004 after the war. In summer, divers jump 20 m into the Neretva.

sights.name: Kujundžiluk
sights.blurb: The cobbled old bazaar on the east bank, lined with copper workshops and souvenir stalls.

sights.name: Koski Mehmed Pasha Mosque
sights.blurb: Climb the minaret for the classic view of the Old Bridge. The courtyard terrace overlooks the river.

sights.name: Crooked Bridge
sights.blurb: A small stone arch over the Radobolja stream, said to be a trial run for the Old Bridge.

zagreb.blurb: The day train gets in with time to spare before the sleeper, so we get an evening in the old town. Everything below is a short walk from the station.

sights.name: Upper Town & St. Mark's Church
sights.blurb: Cobbled Gornji Grad and the church with the tiled coat-of-arms roof.

sights.name: Sljeme by gondola
sights.blurb: The gondola climbs 5 km up Medvednica to the summit of Sljeme for forest walks and a view over the whole city. Check the last ride down.

sights.name: Museum of Broken Relationships
sights.blurb: Objects left behind by ended relationships, each with its story. Funny and moving. Check the closing time.

sights.name: Tkalčićeva street
sights.blurb: The café-and-bar street below the Upper Town, for a drink before the night train.

food.name: La Štruk
food.blurb: A whole menu of štrukli, the baked cheese pastry Zagreb is proud of, in a little courtyard off Tkalčićeva.

food.name: Lanterna na Dolcu
food.blurb: Traditional Croatian cooking under the brick vaults of an old cellar, just behind the Dolac market.
